verdict.rationale: Lorikeet ships an official MCP server (verified live at mcp.lorikeetcx.ai) plus documented natural-language skills like building workflows, testing tools, diagnosing tickets, and creating simulations via commands such as '/lorikeet:create-simulations build simulations for the refund workflow' and 'Test the get-order-status tool with order ID 98765'. This lets AI-native users operate the product conversationally from Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of real-world natural-language command usage beyond vendor docs and probes.
